run_grpc_tests: run grpc tests in parallel for a specified language with configurable compiler and architecture
build_test_config: build a Config object to construct JobSpec entries for test binaries with timeout and environment settings
run_tests_with_docker: run grpc test suite inside a docker container for isolated language-specific test environments
generate_xml_report: generate a JUnit-compatible XML report of test results with optional multi-target output
run_sanity_tests: run sanity checks including clang-format and clang-tidy via the sanity language test suite
